sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: You have got to be kidding me.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exasperated and incredulous, with a sharp burst of frustration at the bad luck of being delayed on the very first day.
sprite_sequence.label: angry

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on... move already.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is impatient and stressed, urgently trying to push through the delay while barely holding back her frustration about being late on the very first day.
sprite_sequence.label: angry

sprite_sequence.text: Okay. It's fine. New term, fresh start, and I'm sweating before homeroom.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is trying to talk herself into staying upbeat, but underneath the joking words she feels frazzled, embarrassed, and already overwhelmed by how badly the morning is going.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and urgently determined, pushing through the crowd with embarrassed energy while trying to stay upbeat and not let the bad start shake her.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: Breathless and relieved to have arrived at last, with a burst of triumphant energy under the lingering stress of being late.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She freezes in sudden embarrassment and awkward realization, her earlier rush collapsing into a small, self-conscious panic as she notices she has walked into the wrong room.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s abruptly embarrassed and flustered, trying to recover her composure with a practical question while realizing she’s barged into the wrong classroom.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Right! Great! Love that for me.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s mortified and flustered by the embarrassing mistake, but is forcing a bright, joking front to recover her composure and save face.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and embarrassed from barging into the wrong classroom, but quickly forcing herself to stay upbeat and polite so she can recover without losing face.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Seriously? You may have just saved my life.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels intensely relieved and grateful, with her embarrassment easing into relieved humor as she warmly overstates the help Mika gave her.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.text: Here! Present. Very present. Extremely sorry.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed from being late and getting the room wrong, but is trying to recover with upbeat, self-deprecating energy and a determined desire to make a good impression.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: I can't believe that happened before nine in the morning.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and overwhelmed by the morning’s chaos, but is already turning it into amused, self-deprecating relief now that the worst has passed.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.text: Recovered? I entered the wrong class like I was making a dramatic entrance.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s embarrassed but laughing it off with self-deprecating humor, trying to turn a mortifying mistake into something playful and confident.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.text: Then I'll call it confidence and not a total disaster.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s joking herself back into composure, turning embarrassment into playful confidence while still feeling a lingering blush of self-consciousness.
sprite_sequence.label: smile

sprite_sequence.text: Hey, since I already embarrassed myself in front of half the first years... want to stick together at lunch?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sheepish but upbeat, turning her embarrassment into a friendly, hopeful bid for companionship and relief.
sprite_sequence.label: smile
